statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain header 'Ordinance Nos, 13 of 1946 Act Nos, 9 of 1950 29 of 1953 10 of 1955 22 of 1955 49 of 2000'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py into a 95-section tree in 8 parts with 18 definitions; the First and Second Schedules are referenced but not transcribed. Other sources inspected: the FAOLEX text-layer PDF of Cap. 605 (chain to 22 of 1955, marginal notes, 87 sections), used as the verification source; the section index (77 legacy entries); the commencement CSV; the three held scans, whose title pages were read; the 49 of 2000 HTML. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 49 of 2000. Review performed: all 87 pre-2000 section numbers located in the print; opening words of every section searched in the print, with every difference explained by the 2000 Act's replacements, insertions and general word substitutions; every heading compared with the print's marginal notes, with sections 5, 36, 39, 40 and 51 corrected and the HTML readings kept in heading_raw; the last provision of the six longest sections read against the print (66, 85, 54, 81 matched; 3 and 4A are 2000 text); 81(1) and the repealed 12(3)-(4) restructured; validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and every remaining warning is documented in the trees. Not read word for word throughout. Amendment coverage: 5 instruments in the chain plus Law No. 37 of 1973 known only from a marker in the print; 9 of 1950, 10 of 1955 and 37 of 1973 not held; 29 of 1953 and 22 of 1955 (omnibus) held as scans; 49 of 2000 held as HTML and scan; all already incorporated in the baseline, nothing applied. Tree included for 49 of 2000 (HTML); its `amends` was filled from the long title; it lacks the bodies of inserted 4A and 4B, which the consolidated tree holds. Structural weaknesses: the 2000 text (long title, sections 2-4, 4A, 4B, 5A-5E, 88) rests on LankaLaw transcriptions alone; the heading of 39 is corrected at moderate confidence; the schedules are not held. Section count discrepancy: index 77 (legacy scrape of the 1955 print with garbled headings and a phantom '5O') versus HTML 95 versus print 87 (1-87, before the seven 2000 insertions and section 88). Missing sources: Acts 9 of 1950 and 10 of 1955; Law 37 of 1973; a Government Printer text of the principal Ordinance; the schedules. Unresolved questions: the identity of Law No. 37 of 1973; the commencement date (head date 1st January, 1947 used; CSV says 1946-01-01). Lawyer verification: unverified.
